description: Expanded quality baseline: 12 bug/clean pairs and 4 behavior controls, 3 samples each, one frozen read-only profile, collected after the source is frozen.
scoring: Recall: bug trials whose report has one main-list finding at min_severity or higher that matches every pattern and, for a pair with bug.location, names bug.location.path; errors count as not detected.
Clean success: a complete report with no Critical or Warning main-list finding; an empty, cut-off, incomplete or error output is never a clean success.
False positives: Critical or Warning main-list findings in clean trials whose status is ok.
Needs human verification, pre-existing and already-raised findings never count, as before.
Controls pass only when every check of the control passes, including an unchanged worktree.
Exit code, status, error class, report validity, completeness, detection or false positives, gate exit and worktree state are separate fields of every trial.
error_policy: Only error_class infrastructure is retryable, at most once per trial, with --attempt 2; every attempt is kept and the aggregator rejects any other retry.
Setup, timeout, agent_exit and format errors, refusals and unfavorable results are measured outcomes and are never retried.

A setup error or a report with both 'Cannot review:' and 'was refused' in sample s1 pauses collection for diagnosis, with every attempt kept; only command or environment evidence of a harness or profile defect leads to a source repair and a new complete study, otherwise the outcomes stay measured and the same study resumes.
A scorer-only defect is fixed with tests and rescored on the same raw outputs; a runtime, command, profile or prompt change needs a new complete study, with the old data kept.

An infrastructure classification alone is not retry permission: actual CLI/transport evidence must establish infrastructure failure; stdout model prose or ambiguous stdout-only matches are retained without retry and reported.
